_comment: City/State configuration for Jharkhand (representative of Ranchi/Jamshedpur urban areas). Fields: rent_baseline (₹/month if Renting; 0 if Own is applied in code), food_multiplier (multiplies a base per-person food cost), transport_baseline (₹/month baseline for public transport; own vehicle may be higher), misc_multiplier (multiplier for miscellaneous costs). All values are safe defaults and can be tuned.
